support.scope: All available named channels and used dates on the native grid.

features.definition: 10 log10 of measured linear gamma-zero power.
features.physical_meaning: Co-polarized return responds to structure, roughness, moisture and viewing geometry.

directional_texture.definition: Empirical directional differences over measured cell pairs. Gradients and trends can dominate.

patches.interpretation: Footprints of signed radar changes at this posting. Edge and mask clipping are recorded.

gp.scope: Fixed common-grid mean dB treated as one representative scalar process.
gp.interpretation: Conditional empirical-Bayes latent-state distribution at observed dates. Regional mean is treated as one scalar process with the shared fitted pixel covariance; its variance is not reduced by pixel count. Hyperparameter, mean and model uncertainty are omitted; residual variance is not identified speckle noise. Not calibrated sensor uncertainty.
